enabled.name: Connection · Enable MCP Bridge
enabled.hint: Master switch to enable/disable the MCP bridge connection

connectionType.name: Connection · Connection Type
connectionType.hint: Auto: Smart selection (HTTPS→WebRTC, HTTP→WebSocket). WebRTC: Encrypted P2P (works over internet). WebSocket: Traditional (localhost only).

serverHost.name: Connection · Websocket Server Host
serverHost.hint: IP address for local Websocket Server connections to the MCP Server (usually localhost). Not used for Remote Connections

serverPort.name: Connection · Server Port
serverPort.hint: Port number for MCP server communication

allowWriteOperations.name: Permissions · Allow Write Operations
allowWriteOperations.hint: Let AI model create actors, NPCs, and modify world content. Reading is always allowed.

maxActorsPerRequest.name: Limits · Max Actors Per Request
maxActorsPerRequest.hint: Maximum number of actors AI model can create in a single request

mapGenAutoStart.name: Map generation · Auto-start Map Generation Service
mapGenAutoStart.hint: Starts the map generation service (ComfyUI) on startup. Off by default because it uses a lot of memory.

mapGenQuality.name: Map generation · Generation Quality
mapGenQuality.hint: Higher quality = better detail but slower generation. Generation time depends on your hardware.

enableNotifications.name: Notifications · Show Connection Messages
enableNotifications.hint: Display notifications when connecting/disconnecting from AI model

autoReconnectEnabled.name: Notifications · Auto-Reconnect on Disconnect
autoReconnectEnabled.hint: Automatically try to reconnect if the connection to AI model is lost

heartbeatInterval.name: Notifications · Connection Check Frequency
heartbeatInterval.hint: How often to check if AI model is still connected (seconds)

permScenes.name: Permissions · Scenes
permScenes.hint: Create, update and delete scenes. Active scenes are always protected.

permActors.name: Permissions · Actors
permActors.hint: Actors and their items. Careful with player characters.

permFolders.name: Permissions · Folders
permFolders.hint: Sidebar folders. Deleting one moves its contents up a level.

permCompendiums.name: Permissions · Compendiums
permCompendiums.hint: Create, fill and organise your own world compendiums. Compendiums from modules and systems are left alone.

writableCompendiums.name: Permissions · Writable compendiums
writableCompendiums.hint: Ids of compendiums that may be edited, separated by commas (e.g. ninjo-kompendium.journale). A bare module name covers all of its compendiums. Leave empty to allow every unlocked compendium.

enhancedIndexMenu.name: Enhanced Creature Index
enhancedIndexMenu.label: Configure Enhanced Index
enhancedIndexMenu.hint: The Enhanced Creature Index pre-computes creature statistics for instant filtering by Challenge Rating, creature type, and abilities. This enables AI models to quickly find creatures matching specific criteria without loading every compendium entry.

mapGenerationSettings.name: Map Generation Service Configuration
mapGenerationSettings.label: Configure Map Generation
mapGenerationSettings.hint: Configure your map generation service for AI-powered battlemap creation. Currently supports ComfyUI installations with plans for future cloud services.

status.label: Status
status.disconnected: ❌ Disconnected — use the connection panel to connect

mapgen.title: Map generation
mapgen.intro: Creates battlemaps through an AI service. ComfyUI runs on the same machine as the MCP server.
mapgen.autoStartHint: Off by default because the service uses a lot of memory.
mapgen.qualityHint: Higher quality gives more detail but takes longer. Generation time depends on your hardware.

index.title: Enhanced creature index
index.intro: Pre-computes creature statistics so you can filter instantly by challenge rating, type and abilities, without loading every compendium entry.
index.rebuildHint: Needed when creature searches stop matching, or after adding compendium packs. Takes roughly 30 to 60 seconds depending on the number of packs.

compendiumAccess.name: Writable compendiums
compendiumAccess.label: Choose compendiums
compendiumAccess.hint: Decides which compendiums the AI model may edit.
compendiumAccess.title: Writable compendiums
compendiumAccess.intro: Decides which compendiums the AI model may create, fill and organise. A tick means: work on this one is allowed. If it is locked, the lock is lifted for the single operation and restored afterwards. Anything left unticked stays untouched, even when unlocked. With nothing ticked at all, only the lock counts: every unlocked compendium may then be edited.
compendiumAccess.allowAllHint: The simplest setting. Unlocking something means you want to work on it.

migration.uebernommen: Carried over {anzahl} settings from the previous module id.
